summary.zh: 水生植物，叶片疏水（荷叶效应）。看似睡莲，在进化树上却相隔甚远。
summary.en: An aquatic plant with water-repellent leaves. It looks like a water lily but sits far from it on the tree.

field_marks.zh: 盾状叶挺出水面，叶柄有刺；花大，单生；莲蓬中有多个孔穴。
field_marks.en: Peltate leaves held above water on prickly stalks; large solitary flowers; a perforated seed head.

similar.zh: 睡莲叶漂浮在水面，叶有深裂缝；莲叶挺水，无裂缝。
similar.en: Water-lily leaves float and have a cleft; lotus leaves stand above water and have none.

story.zh: 莲基因组研究发现其缺少核心真双子叶植物共有的古三倍化事件，并有自己谱系特有的全基因组复制，替换速率较慢。
story.en: The lotus genome lacks the ancient triplication shared by core eudicots, shows a lineage-specific whole-genome duplication, and evolves slowly.

notes.zh: 盛花期约 6–8 月，清晨开放最佳；秋季为枯荷与莲蓬。
notes.en: Peak bloom June–August, best at dawn; autumn brings dried leaves and seed heads.
